elara_gc08_exp_network_diagnosis.title: Turn Counterphase Into a Network Question
elara_gc08_exp_network_diagnosis.interpretation: Elara receives the counterphase principle only after the player brings it to her and reframes it as a network preparation problem rather than a crypt result.

gronk_gc08_exp_counterphase_briefed.title: Tell Gronk What the Network Must Carry
gronk_gc08_exp_counterphase_briefed.interpretation: Gronk learns the counterphase principle as a load-path problem because the player deliberately briefs him; the fact is not inferred from friendship.

valerius_gc08_exp_watch_mobilized.title: Institutional Support, Not Personal Favor
valerius_gc08_exp_watch_mobilized.interpretation: Valerius commits Watch logistics only because the player has enough institutional standing to make the briefing actionable; personal Relationship state is not a substitute.

elara_gc08_exp_distributed_preparation.title: Distributed Manual Preparation
elara_gc08_exp_distributed_preparation.interpretation: The player prepares a distributed response using ordinary verified procedures. It is slower and less specialized, but it remains a legal baseline.

gronk_gc08_exp_structural_preparation.title: Structural Network Preparation
gronk_gc08_exp_structural_preparation.interpretation: The player prepares the network around the actual load paths that will carry the counterphase instead of spreading preparation evenly.

elara_gc08_exp_diagnostic_preparation.title: Diagnostic Network Preparation
elara_gc08_exp_diagnostic_preparation.interpretation: The player seeds diagnostic checks where the Echo's model is most likely to break, using the network as an adversarial sensor rather than a uniform shield.

lyra_gc08_exp_commit_distributed.title: Distributed Network Commitment
lyra_gc08_exp_commit_distributed.interpretation: The player commits to a distributed posture: broad verified preparation with fewer specialized dependencies.

lyra_gc08_exp_commit_structural.title: Structural Network Commitment
lyra_gc08_exp_commit_structural.interpretation: The player commits to a structural posture centered on the load paths most capable of carrying the counterphase.

lyra_gc08_exp_commit_diagnostic.title: Diagnostic Network Commitment
lyra_gc08_exp_commit_diagnostic.interpretation: The player commits to a diagnostic posture designed to detect and exploit contradiction in the Echo's next phase.

lyra_gc08_exp_commit_fortified.title: Fortified Network Commitment
lyra_gc08_exp_commit_fortified.interpretation: The player commits to a fortified posture that combines verified baseline preparation with available Watch logistics.

gronk_gc08_exp_constraint_bottleneck_pre.title: Protect What Actually Carries the Procedure
gronk_gc08_exp_constraint_bottleneck_pre.interpretation: The player applies Gronk's constraint-first judgment independently of Structural Steward, identifying and protecting the dependencies that actually carry the distributed procedure.

lyra_gc08_exp_adversarial_stress_test.title: Red-Team the Procedure Before the Echo Does
lyra_gc08_exp_adversarial_stress_test.interpretation: The player applies Lyra's adversarial calibration independently of Countermodeler, predicting how the distributed procedure is most likely to fail and testing those weaknesses before deployment.
